title: A displayed disjunction interpolation derivation repeats the left principal formula.
details: Corrected December 2025 PDF, printed p. 14 (PDF p. 19), last displayed derivation in the ∨l induction case. The second IH premise is printed φ,Γ⇒Δ,θ2 while the induction hypothesis directly above gives ψ,Γ⇒Δ,θ2, and its weakened conclusion correctly uses ψ. Replace that single φ by ψ. The interpolation construction θ=θ1∨θ2 and atom-support argument are unchanged. This finding concerns the inspected corrected version; it is not an assertion about an upstream repair or the entire notes. Current corpus adoption: propositional-proof-interpolation#left-conjunction uses the two distinct child formulas in the corresponding one-sided NNF conjunction reduction; the interpolant is their disjunction.
